items.author: Robert Taylor, Senior Analytics Specialist at JLL, 3x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 19
items.summary: Gave Claude his February Tableau Desktop snowboarding dashboard (Yuto Totsuka's gold run) and had it rebuilt as a Tableau Data App with better pop-outs and animation, "the future of #DataApps." [Original viz](https://lnkd.in/eKRsVf59), [Data App](https://lnkd.in/e37H-Xza). 7 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Maheswararao Poliparthi, Tableau Lead & BI Architect, Nov 19
items.summary: "Everest Snow & Ice," a 3D Mount Everest rendered in WebGL from public elevation data, running live as a Tableau Cloud Data App with a 25-year snowline animation; built with Claude Code, code and workbooks shared on [GitHub](https://lnkd.in/gFY-Qcaw). Counts not shown.

items.author: Lisa Hitch, MPH, coaches data consultants at The Information Lab, 2x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 19
items.summary: Added her real client-based balance-sheet app (with its prompts) to Tableau's new Data App Wall, and asks whether the wall will fill up with "AI slop"; Kirk Munroe replies that generic dashboards lack insight. 11 reactions, 3 comments.

items.author: Lisa Hitch, MPH, Nov 19
items.summary: "Would you let AI build your next dashboard? I would!!" Video on being impressed by Tableau Studio, especially Data Apps. 5 reactions, 2 reposts.

items.author: Matt Christos Filbert, Lead AI Software Engineer of Tableau Studio, Nov 19
items.summary: Asks the #datafam for wishes (not bugs) to level up Tableau Studio, starting with "Studio from your phone via Tableau Mobile"; replies ask for user-level instructions, voice, choice of LLMs, and Prep inside Studio. A direct line to the product team. 23 reactions, 9 comments, 6 reposts.

items.author: Reid Grimm, Tableau, Nov 19
items.summary: Tableau Studio went GA this week; after building with it he calls it a game changer, citing Tableau Skills guiding prompts, unmetered spend, and governed building for business users. 20 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.

items.author: Alex Mou, Sr Data Visualization Architect, 5x Tableau Visionary, Nov 19
items.summary: Built [10KDecoder.com](https://10KDecoder.com), a self-updating site that turns SEC filings for about 3,000 companies into roughly 20,000 dashboards and infographics using AI automation. 3 reactions.

items.author: Warren Dean, founder of DataTale, Power BI for government, Nov 18
items.summary: Power BI Desktop for Apps is in public preview: an in-chat AI app builder he likens to Claude Design (Microsoft's answer to Tableau Data Apps). 168 reactions, 13 comments, 11 reposts.

items.author: Modivcare
items.summary: Vice President, Reporting and Data Analytics — Modivcare — Remote (US) — posted Nov 19 — $202.3K–$250K + bonus — Hospitals and Health Care. Leads data, reporting and analytics for Personal Care Services: governance, integration/warehousing/ETL, BI and KPI dashboards, executive insights, building a senior team. 15+ years in analytics/BI, 10+ leading teams; SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI; healthcare preferred.

items.summary: Tableau officially announced Data Apps and Tableau Studio GA; Chris Westlake's Scotland TUG (Dec 3, Edinburgh); Priya Padham's AstraNova sci-fi Data App; Lorna Brown's Friends Data App prompting series; Carlos Aguilar on Hex's knowledge graph for analytics agents; Paweł Kułakowski on PBIP + Claude data safety (83 reactions).
